items.text: Breece Hall officially inactive for Jets vs Dolphins; quad strain after missing three games.
items.why: Unlikely earlier per Rapoport; not full participant.
items.implication: Continue with backup RBs; no Hall usage.

items.text: Lamar Jackson ruled OUT for Week 7 vs Bengals with ankle injury; Tyler Huntley expected to start again.
items.why: Downgraded Saturday; was close but not ready per reports.
items.implication: Fade Ravens pass game volume; Huntley limited upside.

items.text: Full Sun morning summary: GTD Mike Washington; GTD-opt Puka; GTD-pess Breece (now inactive); IN Jacobs/Coleman/Kirk/Mason/Dell/Sampson; Expected Saquon; OUT Lamar/Smith/Wicks. Projections updated.
items.why: Gold-standard weekend reports aggregation.

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks ruled OUT for Eagles MNF vs Cowboys.
items.why: Injury report confirmation.
items.implication: Elevated targets for remaining Eagles pass catchers; reverse prior DeVonta love.

items.text: Lamar, Puka, Breece statuses crucial to Sunday DFS main slate; projections updated on latest news including ETR summary.
items.why: Direct impact on slate construction and ownership.
items.implication: Pivot lineups on final inactives; Puka opt high priority.

items.text: Puka Nacua GTD with optimism; Rams confident he plays vs Raiders if no setbacks on calf.
items.why: Feeling better Saturday; Schefter sources optimistic.
items.implication: Start if active; high upside WR1 range.

items.text: Saquon Barkley expected to play Monday vs Cowboys despite questionable (hamstring).
items.why: Returned to practice; Rapoport/ETR align on expected.
items.implication: Strong RB start vs soft Dallas run D.

items.text: Josh Jacobs activated and expected to play Sunday at Detroit after exempt list.
items.why: Official activation Saturday.
items.implication: RB volume return but workload question post-layoff.

items.text: Saquon Barkley in line to play MNF; loves if active for efficiency + Dallas RB matchup (ranked RB15).
items.why: Efficient prior; soft matchup.

items.text: Rico Dowdle is up (active) for Steelers; DeShon Elliott also.
items.why: Inactives confirmation.

items.text: Lamar Jackson was close to playing this week, should next week; Huntley starts.
items.why: Insiders update; ankle progress but not enough.

items.text: Sneaky important scratches: Brian Robinson, Tyler Warren, Emeka Egbuka (among others) that some may have missed.
items.why: Confirmed on ETR injury dump.

items.text: Tempted to buy CMC lining up more at slot amid 49ers WR outs (Evans/Deebo/Adams) despite usual skepticism on RB-as-WR claims; Kaelon Black presence noted.
items.why: Dire WR situation + CMC smile comment; rarely true but this week different.
items.opportunity: Slot snaps/routes expand with WRs out.

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown @ CHI for usage/matchup; Bears good for yardage.
items.why: Real role back + favorable matchup.

items.text: Loves Tucker Kraft @ DET; Lions TE buffet (allowed 9 TE TDs).
items.why: Detroit vulnerable to TEs; volume expected.

items.text: Loves Jaylen Warren @ NO, Chuba Hubbard vs TB, Bucky Irving @ CAR for big workloads in friendly matchups.
items.why: Volume + defenses carved by RBs; consistent for Hubbard.

items.text: Hates Rome Odunze vs NE (Gonzalez shadow), Josh Downs @ MIN (target share/low scoring), Travis Kelce @ SEA (tough D).
items.why: Nasty matchups and diminished roles.

items.text: Hates Josh Jacobs @ DET post-layoff; workload questions after long absence.
items.why: Layoff rust/workload uncertainty vs tough Lions.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall officially inactive today after being unlikely to play while returning from quad strain.
items.why: Hasn't been full participant; early in return from three-game absence.
items.implication: Jets RB committee or backup lead; major fantasy scratch.
items.opportunity: Full snaps/carries to other Jets RBs.

items.text: Lamar Jackson ruled OUT for Week 7 vs Bengals; Tyler Huntley expected to start. Confirmed in ETR Sunday morning summary after Saturday downgrade.
items.why: Ankle injury; close but downgraded overnight/Saturday.
items.implication: Ravens offense downgrade; Huntley start impacts all skill players.
items.opportunity: Reduced QB rushing/ dual-threat; potential volume shift to RBs/WRs under Huntley.

items.text: Texans WR Tank Dell activated and ACTIVE for first NFL action in nearly two years; officially active today.
items.why: Activated Saturday; set for return.
items.implication: Potential target share in HOU WR room.

items.text: Bucs QB Baker Mayfield ACTIVE today with protective glove for dislocated thumb; returns after absence.
items.why: Thumb protected; returns first time since Sept 27.

items.text: Titans WR Calvin Ridley inactive today.
items.why: Listed among inactives.
items.opportunity: Increased share for other Titans WRs.

items.text: Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY Monday vs Cowboys despite questionable (hamstring); ETR and Rapoport align.
items.why: Returned to practice; expected after hamstring absence.
items.implication: Lead back role if active vs favorable DAL matchup.
items.opportunity: Primary carries/snaps; DeVonta/Wicks OUT boosts pass game too.

items.why: Calf improved; sources confident if no setbacks.
items.implication: Likely WR1 usage if active; Adams already OUT.
items.opportunity: High target share in depleted Rams WR room.

items.text: Giants RB Cam Skattebo expected to resume lead back role vs Texans.
items.why: Sources confirm lead role return.

items.why: Hamstring (Smith); ankle (Wicks). Final report.
items.implication: PHI pass catchers thinned; targets to remaining WRs/TE.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for other Eagles pass-catchers.
